sections.title: ATHA is a collaborative AI‑native innovation experience.
sections.text: ATHA brings together education, research, industry and talent to solve real challenges. It aims for extraordinary value while making work healthier, more joyful and responsible, showing that innovation and human flourishing can strengthen each other.

sections.title: A day in the ATHA experience feels collaborative and humane.
sections.text: Participants work in a temporary culture that rejects pressure and exhaustion. Teams explore AI‑native collaboration, seeing how ideas develop, decisions are made and human judgement works alongside artificial intelligence.

sections.title: ATHA exists to unite AI, people and industry for healthier innovation.
sections.text: Its mission is to create AI‑native experiences that let people tackle real industry challenges, understand AI holistically, and develop capabilities for a responsible, joyful future of work.

sections.title: Each ATHA edition follows a seven‑step rhythm.
sections.text: The rhythm moves from arrival and settling, through opening the question, connecting teams, creating with AI, discerning evidence, celebrating shared success, and finally integrating outcomes for the next edition.

stages.name: Arrive & Settle
stages.description: People are met rather than processed; the room is made, not booked.

stages.name: Open & Sense
stages.description: The question is opened before it is attacked, presented as it actually sits.

stages.name: Connect
stages.description: Teams form across disciplines, around the question.

stages.name: Create
stages.description: The longest stage: AI-native investigation, AI used fully, never accepted blindly.

stages.name: Discern
stages.description: Evidence, consequences, uncertainty, trade-offs — given more room than any stage except the work itself.

stages.name: Celebrate
stages.description: Recognition is shared rather than ranked; different forms of excellence, no overall winner.

stages.name: Integrate & Return
stages.description: Leave with something integrated; the relationships carry into the next edition.

sections.title: OneMundi and Warwick Business School drive the ATHA programme.
sections.text: OneMundi initiates the AI‑native methodology, commercial model and ongoing ecosystem. Warwick Business School provides the academic environment, participants, research support and institutional standards.

layers.name: OneMundi
layers.description: Initiator and owner. Enterprise transformation, the AI-native methodology, the commercial model, the independence of the verdict, and the ecosystem that continues between editions.

layers.name: Warwick Business School
layers.description: Partner and co-host. Academic environment, knowledge, participants, research, network and institutional standards.

sections.title: Team roles are matched to skills rather than just AI interest.
sections.text: Recruitment focuses on five required team functions, selecting participants based on demonstrated skills and interests rather than solely on academic subject.

sections.title: The first ATHA edition is being planned with several proposed elements.
sections.text: The plan currently includes around 45 selected participants, nine multidisciplinary teams, three real enterprise AI challenges and a multi‑day experience at Warwick Business School. Later showcases and exact dates are still being shaped.
